issues.recommendation: Figma shows #222222 for the Name placeholder text, but the TextInput component uses #444444. However, #222222 is very close to background #131313 and would be nearly invisible. The #444444 value matches the Phone input placeholder color and provides better contrast. The Figma #222222 may be the INPUT CONTAINER background fill (visible:false), NOT the actual placeholder. Comment in TextInput.tsx line 21-22 confirms this interpretation. NO CHANGE NEEDED — #444444 is correct.
